SELECT ACC_APP_ADAPTER.APP_ADAPTER_TRANS_SEQ.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO ACC_APP_ADAPTER.APP_ADAPTER_TRANS ( ID, SYSTEM_ID, REQUEST_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DATA, STATUS, RESP_CODE, RESP_DESC, INS_TS, UPD_TS ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{systemId}, #{requestId}, #{eventType}, #{data}, #{status}, #{respCode}, #{respDesc}, #{insTs}, #{updTs} )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, SYSTEM_ID, REQUEST_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DATA, STATUS, RESP_CODE, RESP_DESC, INS_TS, UPD_TS FROM ACC_APP_ADAPTER.APP_ADAPTER_TRANS
mapper.update: UPDATE ACC_APP_ADAPTER.APP_ADAPTER_TRANS SET STATUS = #{status}, RESP_CODE = #{respCode}, RESP_DESC = #{respDesc}, UPD_TS = SYSDATE WHERE ID = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ID, SYSTEM_ID, REQUEST_ID, EVENT_TYPE, DATA, STATUS, RESP_CODE, RESP_DESC, INS_TS, UPD_TS FROM ACC_APP_ADAPTER.APP_ADAPTER_TRANS WHERE STATUS NOT IN ('SUCCESS','ERROR') AND REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalCompleted, MIN(INS_TS) AS firstStartTime, MAX(UPD_TS) AS lastFinishTime, NVL(ROUND((MAX(UPD_TS) - MIN(INS_TS)) * 86400, 2), 0) AS totalDurationSeconds, NULL AS formattedDuration, NVL(ROUND(AVG((UPD_TS - INS_TS) * 86400), 4), 0) AS avgDurationSeconds, NVL(ROUND(MAX((UPD_TS - INS_TS) * 86400), 4), 0) AS maxDurationSeconds, 0 AS batchesPerSecond, 0 AS estimatedRowsProcessed FROM ACC_APP_ADAPTER.APP_ADAPTER_TRANS WHERE STATUS IN ('SUCCESS', 'ERROR')
